from regression_support import *
t=Turn('CONT_DISPOSITIONS');s=t.before
session=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='session' and r['topic']=='Continuity review');t.p['session_id']=session['id']
def named(name):return next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']==name)
runa=named('Rúna');freyja=named('Freyja');boat=named('Only usable boat');escape=named('Planned escape');sinking=named('Ship sinking');arrival=named('Rúna harbour arrival');letter=named('Letter');delivery=named('Letter arrival');boundary=named('Sealed boundary')
def element(name,kind,fragment,status='proposed'):
 r=t.base('story_element',fragment);r.update(element_type=kind,display_name=name,aliases=[],status=status,assertion_ids=[],relationship_ids=[],dependency_refs=[],time_ref=timing(),decision_ids=[]);return t.add(r)
def get_bundle(finding_id):
 finding=s[finding_id];idea=next(s[r['id']] for r in finding['affected_refs'] if s[r['id']]['kind']=='idea');ev=next(s[r['id']] for r in finding['affected_refs'] if s[r['id']]['kind']=='story_element' and s[r['id']].get('status')=='proposed');return finding,idea,ev
def disposition(finding,fragment,status,action,old_records,results,reason):
 f=t.revise(finding,fragment);f['disposition']=status
 d=t.decision(action,fragment,[finding]+old_records,[f]+results,[],reason,[finding]+old_records)
 f['decision_ids'].append(d['id'])
 for r in results:
  if 'decision_ids' in r:r['decision_ids'].append(d['id'])
 return f,d

f='reject the betrayal idea'

rf,rd=disposition(of,f,'rejected_idea','reject',[oi,oe],[ni,ne],'Reject the betrayal proposal while preserving the protective oath.')
notes.append('1. Betrayal rejected ('+cite(ni)+'; decision '+cite(rd)+'); finding '+cite(rf)+' is rejected_idea. Rúna’s oath remains unchanged (249f979b r1).')

of,oi,oe=get_bundle('d0614c62-ba76-46ed-9f38-2514585ed35a')
oldlearn=s['e7860735-5143-462d-8358-727436f2376f'];oldbefore=s['82dc2970-0fc0-44fb-a904-242c882e0eb5'];oldafter=s['da98ac0d-9394-437b-a84e-b58340400e68'];oldlearning=named('Rúna learns rescue code')

for old in (oldlearn,oldbefore,oldafter,oldlearnidea):
 x=t.revise(old,f);x['status']='superseded';superseded.append(x)

learning['assertion_ids']=[learn['id'],knows['id']]
li=t.idea('Rúna learned the rescue code before the ship sank.',f,[runa,sinking,learning],'accepted');li['resulting_assertion_ids']=[learn['id'],knows['id']]
results=superseded+[learning,learn,knows,li]

notes.append('5. The apparent crossing is now an intentional unreliable witness’s false account ('+cite(intent)+'; false-account assertion '+cite(false)+'; technique decision '+cite(canon)+').
